title: Asiad: Marie June Adriano claims bronze for PH's second medal in karate
summary: Marie June Adriano won the Philippines' second medal in karate in the 2026 Asian Games after capturing bronze in the women's -50kg class in kumite on Wednesday in Toyohashi City.
